import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before,(name,'mutated')

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
check('missing',{'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
check('filters',{'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'wrong-claim','claim':'y','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'unverified','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'wrong-condition','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':3},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('eligible-supersession',{'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'old','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'ineligible','claim':'x','value':3,'conditions':{'a':9,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check('canonical-agreement',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'z','claim':'x','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{}},{'source':'a','claim':'x','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]}, {'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('conflict-count-no-authority',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'a','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{}},{'source':'b','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{}},{'source':'c','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('boolean-false',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'f','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
check('numeric-zero',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'n','claim':'x','value':0,'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
check('absent-calibration',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'n','claim':'x','conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert actual==report,(actual,report)
print(json.dumps({'checks':9,'report':actual},sort_keys=True))
